theme_archetype: Performance Pro (Dark Theme) - Construction Field Tool
design_philosophy: A high-visibility, technical command center for field measurements. Clone the exact visual identity from provided MesureChâssis references, replacing all orange accents (#FF6B00 / #FF8C42) with Vert Pomme (#8CC63F).

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'testID' (React Native) attribute.

login.layout: Tabs for Connexion / Inscription. Arrow-up logo centered. Form inputs below.

dashboard.header: Bonjour [Name], company name colored in accent_primary. Icons: équipe, stats, megaphone, settings, logout.
dashboard.banner: BETA banner card with beta_banner_bg, tinted text.
dashboard.filters: Search bar + Scrollable filter pills (Tous, À Mesurer, À Vérifier, En Fabrication).
dashboard.list: Projects list mapping to cards. Empty state if 0 projects.
dashboard.cta: Floating CTA '+ NOUVEAU CHANTIER' fixed bottom right.

new_project_modal.layout: Form container. Fields: Nom, Prénom, Adresse, Code Postal, Ville, Date du rendez-vous, Notes.

measurement_flow.layout: Multi-step form with 1-2-3 circular stepper at top.
measurement_flow.step1: Material selection cards (Acier, Bois, Béton) with corresponding icons.
measurement_flow.step2: Numeric inputs (Hauteur, Réserves, Épaisseur dalle, Trémie L/l, Reculement). Toggles for 'Sols finis à zéro?'.
measurement_flow.actions: 'Signaler un problème' button with red (colors.danger) outline.

result_export.layout: Result card displaying dynamic 2D SVG stair elevation + Blondel's Law calculations.
result_export.actions: PDF Export Button, DXF Export Button, Native Share Icon Button.

svg_stair_sketch_spec.description: A dynamic 2D React Native SVG component drawing a stair elevation based on inputs.
elements: Stair steps (marches/contremarches) outlined in accent color.
Dashed lines for slabs (dalles) and trémie.
Dimension lines with text indicating height and run.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, TextInput) and StyleSheet or NativeWind for styling. (.js files, no .tsx)
Strictly adhere to the dark theme #1A1E2A as the primary background.
Ensure every button, input, tab, and card has a proper testID attribute for Expo testing.
Do NOT use any orange color codes (#FF6B00/#FF8C42). Replace all highlight states, active icons, and primary buttons with Vert Pomme #8CC63F.
For the SVG sketch, use react-native-svg to render the 2D elevation.
Remember that the mobile screen layouts must directly clone the MesureChâssis UX flow provided in the screenshots.
